description: This file implements a feature to list comments for a specific article within a web application, utilizing MediatR for request handling and Entity Framework Core for data access.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Contains the request query and handler for listing comments related to an article identified by its slug.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the incoming query to fetch comments for the specified article, returning an envelope of comments or throwing a not found exception.
